items.text: CFA versus MBA in finance is a choice between a self-paced professional exam path focused on investment analysis and an institution-based degree that offers a broader network and management training, and the better choice depends on your target role, your funds, your study discipline and what employers in that role value.
Read ten notices in your target role to see which credential they ask for, count total cost and time, and test your interest with a small valuation exercise.
Check the official bodies and institutions and verify claims about placements.
